The camera slowly zooms in on the couple as they point at something in the distance, the clouds drifting slowly, sunlight breaking through the mist, serene hiking vibe.
Suddenly, the sea of clouds in the distance begins to churn violently, rising upwards unnaturally like a boiling pot, the couple's body language stiffens, sensing something wrong.
A colossal, shadowy silhouette of a Godzilla-like monster rises slowly from the thick clouds, its massive dorsal fins piercing the mist, lightning flashing around it, terrifying scale.
The couple turns around in panic, their faces (side profile) showing pure terror, the man grabs the woman's arm, urging her to run, the camera shaking slightly to reflect tension.
